name: Glen Check
description: A glen check: blocks of tiny pin squares alternating with blocks of fine stripes running across and down, crossed by a thin colored overcheck.

code.style: --rule: ( --m: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3))); --o: @pd(@p(var(--color4), var(--color5))); background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--m) 0 8.333%, transparent 8.333% 16.667%) 100% 0 / 50% 50% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, @var(--m) 0 8.333%, transparent 8.333% 16.667%) 0 100% / 50% 50% no-repeat; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--m), var(--color1)); -webkit-mask: @var(--pins); mask: @var(--pins); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--o); opacity: .85; -webkit-mask: @var(--over); mask: @var(--over); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --pins: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10.417%, transparent 10.417% 16.667%), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 10.417%, transparent 10.417% 16.667%), conic-gradient(from 90deg, #000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg); --over: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, transparent 0%, #000 0% 1.2%, transparent 1.2%, transparent 98.8%, #000 98.8% 100%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, transparent 0%, #000 0% 1.2%, transparent 1.2%, transparent 98.8%, #000 98.8% 100%, transparent 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
